address: Eveleigh Avenue, London Road, West Bath, Somerset,BA1 7JD
bio: Escape the every day to this charming Somerset estate, Bailbrook House Hotel, for the ultimate, quintessential dining experience. Nestled within picturesque gardens, the hotel's striking architecture and impressive interiors create the perfect backdrop to indulge in Afternoon Tea.  Afternoon Tea at Bailbrook House is served in the Mansion House Lounges with beautiful views over the gardens and grounds. In warmer months, Afternoon Tea can be enjoyed alfresco. This elegant yet relaxed setting is the perfect spot to unwind and indulge in this great British tradition.  The Afternoon Tea menu features an array of savoury treats, scones and sweet pastries, along with a wide selection of loose-leaf teas. The talented pastry chefs prepare the scones and cakes freshly each day. The menu is refreshed regularly to celebrate various occasions throughout the year.  Bailbrook House are also able to cater to a wide range of dietary requirements including gluten-free, vegan and have special children's Afternoon Tea options. Why not upgrade you traditional experience with a glass of Champagne or Prosecco for the height of luxury?
